name: manhwa-studio
description: Local full-stack desktop-style web app for manhwa library management and downloading

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: cd server && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
scripts.postinstall: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev:with-kokoro: concurrently -n server,client,kokoro -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:kokoro"
